import re, numpy as np
# extract grid segment given marker, capture 30 lines of numbers

def extract_grid(text, marker):
 s=text.split(marker,1)[1]
 rows=[]
 for line in s.strip().splitlines():
  vals=re.findall(r'(?<!\w)\d+(?!\w)',line)
  if len(vals)==30:
   rows.append(list(map(int,vals)))
   if len(rows)==30: break
 return np.array(rows)
